original: anupapannaṃ syāt | tarhi pūrvodāhmatajāminyuktivirodhaḥ syāditi ceducyate pūrvapakṣyuktaṃ sarveṣāṃ vedavākyānāṃ kāryaparatvamabhyupagamya parihmataṃ jaimininā, na tu tasya tathaivābhiprāya iti dvayorna virodhaḥ | asmin śloke 'viracitakarvicārai 'riti puruṣaviśeṣeṇa karmavicārānantarameva brāhṛvicārasya kartavyatālābhāt brāhṛvicāraṃ prati
analyzed: anupapannam syāt tarhi pūrva udāhmata jāminī ukti virodhaḥ syāt iti ced ucyate pūrvapakṣi uktam sarveṣām veda vākyānām kārya paratvam abhyupagamya parihmatam jaimininā na tu tasya tathā eva abhiprāyaḥ iti dvayoḥ na virodhaḥ asmin śloke iti puruṣa viśeṣeṇa karma vicāra anantaram eva brāhṛ vicārasya kartavya tā alābhāt brāhṛ vicāram prati

original: karmavicārasya niyamena pūrvavṛttatvaṃ labhyate | tat kuta iti ceducyate adhītavedasya puruṣasya vedavākyeṣu karmaphalasya brāhṛjñānaphalasya ca kvacitsthiratve kvacidasthiratve āpātataḥ pratipanne sati anayoḥ kiṃ tātvikamiti nirṇayecchā jāyate | tathā ca tannirṇākaśāstreṣu pravartamānasya puruṣasya karmaphaleṣu tannirṇayaupāyika
analyzed: karma vicārasya niyamena pūrva vṛtta tvam labhyate tat kutas iti ced ucyate adhīta vedasya puruṣasya veda vākyeṣu karma phalasya brāhṛ jñāna phalasya ca kvacid sthira tve kvacid asthira tve āpātataḥ pratipanne sati anayoḥ kim tātvikam iti nirṇaya icchā jāyate tathā ca tad nirṇāka śāstreṣu pravartamānasya puruṣasya karma phaleṣu tad nirṇaya aupāyika artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha artha

original: śāstravicāra eva prathamaṃ pravṛttirjāyate;karmaṇāṃ anādivāsanayā sukaratvaniścayādanabhyastasya brāhṛjñānasya duṣkaratva
analyzed: śāstra vicāre eva prathamam pravṛttiḥ jāyate karmaṇām anādi vāsanayā sukara tva niścayāt anabhyastasya brāhṛ jñānasya duṣkara tva

original: niścayācca laghūpāyenābhimatārthasiddhisaṃbhave gurūpāye pravṛttyayogena karmaphaleṣu tannirṇayecchābrāhṛjñānaphale
analyzed: niścayāt ca laghu upāyena abhimata artha siddhi saṃbhave guru upāye pravṛtti ayogena karma phaleṣu tad nirṇaya icchā brāhṛ jñāna phale

original: tannirṇayaupayikavicāre pravṛtteḥ pratibandhāt | karmavicāre kṛte karmaphalānāṃ asthiratvaniścayo bhavati | tadyathā
analyzed: tad nirṇaya aupayika vicāre pravṛtteḥ pratibandhāt karma vicāre kṛte karma phalānām asthira tva niścayaḥ bhavati tat yathā

original: "dākṣāyaṇayajñena yajeta" iti karmakāṇḍe darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe śrūyate | tatra dākṣāyaṇanāmā kaścidyajñaḥ kiṃ vidhīyate athavā darśapūrṇamāsayoreeva kaśacidguṇo vidhīyata iti saṃśaye jaimininā maharṣiṇā "vikāro vā prakaraṇāt " iti sūtreṇa darśapūṇarmāsayoḥ svargādiphalabhūyastvāyā''vṛttiḥ kartavyā iti śrutyarthaḥ
analyzed: dākṣāyaṇayajñena yajeta iti karmakāṇḍe darśa pūrṇamāsa prakaraṇe śrūyate tatra dākṣāyaṇa nāmā kaścid yajñaḥ kim vidhīyate athavā darśa pūrṇamāsayoḥ kaścid guṇaḥ vidhīyate iti saṃśaye jaimininā mahā ṛṣiṇā vikāraḥ vā prakaraṇāt iti sūtreṇa svarga ādi phala bhūyastvāya āvṛttiḥ kartavyā iti śruti arthaḥ

original: iti nirṇītam | anena darśapūrṇamāsādikarmaṇāṃ phalabhūtaṃ svargādi naśvaramiti niścayo jāyate | darśapūrṇamāsādi
analyzed: iti nirṇītam anena darśa pūrṇamāsa ādi karmaṇām phala bhūtam svarga ādi naśvaram iti niścayaḥ jāyate darśa pūrṇamāsa ādi

original: sādhyasvargādiphalasya nityatve hi tasya cirakālanuvṛtyarthaṃ darśapūrṇamāsāvṛttividhānaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt | evaṃ karmaphalānāṃ
analyzed: sādhya svarga ādi phalasya nitya tve hi tasya cira kāla anuvṛti artham darśa pūrṇamāsa āvṛtti vidhānam vyartham syāt evam karma phalānām

original: anityatvaniścaye karmavicārecchārūpapratibandhakanivṛttau brāhṛvicārecchādhīnā tadvicāre pravṛttirutpadyata iti
analyzed: anitya tva niścaye karma vicāra icchā rūpa pratibandhaka nivṛttau brāhṛ vicāra icchā adhīnā tad vicāre pravṛttiḥ utpadyate iti

original: brāhṛvicārasya niyamena karmavicārasāpekṣatvam ||
analyzed: brāhṛ vicārasya niyamena karma vicāra sāpekṣa tvam

original: astvetat; sūtrābhiprāyavivaraṇāya pravatte'sminpadye sautrapadāspṛṣṭasya brāhṛṇaḥ śrīnivāsa nāmakatvoktiḥ kathamupapadyata iti ceducyate | asminbrāhṛmīmāṃsāśāstre brāhṛṇo jijñāsyatvaṃ pratijñāya jagajjnmādikāraṇatvaṃ tasya lakṣaṇamabhidhāya lakṣye lakṣaṇasamanvayāya taditareṣu tasya vyāvartanāya ca pravṛtteṣu
analyzed: astu etat sūtra abhiprāya vivaraṇāya sautra pada āspṛṣṭasya brāhṛṇaḥ śrīnivāsa nāmaka tva uktiḥ katham upapadyate iti ced ucyate asmin brāhṛ mīmāṃsā śāstre brāhṛṇaḥ jijñāsyatvam pratijñāya jagat jnma ādi kāraṇatvam tasya lakṣaṇam abhidhāya lakṣye lakṣaṇa samanvayāya tad itareṣu tasya vyāvartanāya ca pravṛtteṣu

original: īkṣatyadhikaraṇaprabhṛtiṣvadhikaraṇeṣu puruṣasūktanārāyaṇānuvākasubālopaniṣadādiṣu prasiddhaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ mahāpuruṣaṃ
analyzed: īkṣati adhikaraṇa prabhṛtiṣu adhikaraṇeṣu puruṣasūkta nārāyaṇānuvāka subāla upaniṣad ādiṣu prasiddham śrīnivāsam mahāpuruṣam

original: tadasādhāraṇadharmaviśeṣeḥ pratyabhijñāpya tatra lakṣaṇasamanvayasya taditareṣu vyāvṛttatāyāśca pradarśitatvena sa eva brāhṛpadārthatvena sūtrakārābhimata itīhāpi prathamasūtre brāhṛpadena sa eva vivakṣita iti na tasya sautrapadāspṛṣṭamiti |
analyzed: tad asādhāraṇa dharma viśeṣeḥ pratyabhijñāpya tatra lakṣaṇa samanvayasya tad itareṣu vyāvṛtta tāyāḥ ca pradarśita tvena saḥ eva brāhṛ padārtha tvena sūtrakāra abhimataḥ iti iha api prathama sūtre brāhṛ padena saḥ eva vivakṣitaḥ iti na tasya sautra pada a spṛṣṭam iti

original: tadetaduttaratra spaṣṭīkariṣyati iti sarvaṃ niravadyam ||
analyzed: tat etat uttaratra spaṣṭīkariṣyati iti sarvam niravadyam

original: iti jijñāsādhikaraṇam || 1 ||
analyzed: iti jijñāsā adhikaraṇam 1
